Title: OpenAPI v3 support in Azure API Management is now generally available

Body.Content:
OpenAPI Specification v3 support in Azure API Management is now generally available. OpenAPI Specification v3 is the latest major version of the broadly used, open-source, programming language-agnostic interface description for REST APIs. Microsoft's work is based on the OpenAPI.NET SDK project.

This version includes fixes and improvements to the preview functionality—for example, it enables support for multipart/form-data content type. API Management also now allows for interoperability of exported APIs between OpenAPI versions—API definitions (including schema definitions) are converted to the selected OpenAPI version format.

The rollout of the new improvements is expected to finish in the second half of February.

Learn more about OpenAPI support limitations and restrictions.

Learn how to import an OpenAPI in API Management
